/*=====================================================
    2️⃣ Calcul Persoane Intretinere
=====================================================*/
;WITH Persoane AS
(
    SELECT
        pi.Marca,

        /*---------------------------------------------
            Copii minori
            FelPersoana = 2
        ---------------------------------------------*/
        COUNT
        (
            CASE
                WHEN pi.FelPersoana = 2
                 AND pi.DataNasteriiCopil >
                     EOMONTH
                     (
                         DATEADD
                         (
                             YEAR,
                             -18,
                             DATEFROMPARTS([Anul],[Luna],1)
                         )
                     )
                THEN 1
            END
        ) AS NumarCopiiMinori,

        /*---------------------------------------------
            Sot / Sotie
            FelPersoana = 1
        ---------------------------------------------*/
        COUNT
        (
            CASE
                WHEN pi.FelPersoana = 1
                THEN 1
            END
        ) AS SotSotie,

        /*---------------------------------------------
            Alte Persoane
            FelPersoana = 4
        ---------------------------------------------*/
        COUNT
(
    CASE
        WHEN pi.FelPersoana = 4
         AND pi.DataNasteriiCopil <=
             EOMONTH
             (
                 DATEADD
                 (
                     YEAR,
                     -26,
                     DATEFROMPARTS([Anul],[Luna],1)
                 )
             )
        THEN 1
    END
) AS AltePersoane,

        /*---------------------------------------------
            Persoane in intretinere sub 26 ani
            FelPersoana = 4
        ---------------------------------------------*/
        COUNT
        (
            CASE
                WHEN pi.FelPersoana = 4
                 AND pi.DataNasteriiCopil >
                     EOMONTH
                     (
                         DATEADD
                         (
                             YEAR,
                             -26,
                             DATEFROMPARTS([Anul],[Luna],1)
                         )
                     )
                THEN 1
            END
        ) AS NumarTineri26,

        /*---------------------------------------------
            Handicap salariat
            FelPersoana = 0
        ---------------------------------------------*/
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN pi.FelPersoana = 0
                THEN pi.Grad
            END
        ) AS GradHandicap

    FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere pi

    INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
        ON s.Marca = pi.Marca
       AND s.CodSucursala = '[CodSucursala]'
       AND s.Anul = [Anul]
       AND s.Luna = [Luna]

    WHERE
        pi.DataDeInceput <= EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS([Anul],[Luna],1))
    AND
    (
        pi.DataDeSfarsit IS NULL
        OR pi.DataDeSfarsit >= DATEFROMPARTS([Anul],[Luna],1)
    )

    GROUP BY
        pi.Marca
)

INSERT INTO app.CalculPersoaneIntretinere
(
    Marca,
    CodSucursala,
    Anul,
    Luna,

    NumarPersoane,
    NumarCopiiMinori,
    NumarTineri26,
    SotSotie,
    AltePersoane,

    Handicap,
    GradHandicap,

    DedSuplimCopii,
    DedSuplimAltePers
)
SELECT
    s.Marca,
    s.CodSucursala,

    [Anul],
    [Luna],

    /*---------------------------------------------
        Total Persoane Intretinere
        MAX 4
    ---------------------------------------------*/
    CASE
        WHEN
        (
            ISNULL(p.NumarCopiiMinori,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.SotSotie,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.NumarTineri26,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.AltePersoane,0)
        ) > 4

        THEN 4

        ELSE
        (
            ISNULL(p.NumarCopiiMinori,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.SotSotie,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.NumarTineri26,0)
            +
            ISNULL(p.AltePersoane,0)
        )
    END AS NumarPersoane,

    ISNULL(p.NumarCopiiMinori,0),

    ISNULL(p.NumarTineri26,0),

    ISNULL(p.SotSotie,0),

    ISNULL(p.AltePersoane,0),

    /*---------------------------------------------
        Handicap
    ---------------------------------------------*/
    CASE
        WHEN p.GradHandicap IN (1,2)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Handicap,

    p.GradHandicap,

    /*---------------------------------------------
        Deduceri suplimentare
    ---------------------------------------------*/
    ISNULL(p.NumarCopiiMinori,0) * 100,

    ISNULL(p.NumarTineri26,0) * 100

FROM app.Salariat s

LEFT JOIN Persoane p
    ON p.Marca = s.Marca

WHERE
    s.CodSucursala = '[CodSucursala]'
AND s.Anul = [Anul]
AND s.Luna = [Luna]

UPDATE c
SET
    CoeficientHandicap =
        ISNULL(x.CoeficientHandicap,0)
FROM app.CalculPersoaneIntretinere c

OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT
        MAX(ISNULL(tp.Procent,0)) AS CoeficientHandicap
    FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere pi

    INNER JOIN app.TipPersoana tp
        ON tp.FelPersoana = pi.FelPersoana
       AND ISNULL(tp.Grad,-1) = ISNULL(pi.Grad,-1)
       AND tp.Anul = c.Anul

    WHERE
        pi.Marca = c.Marca
    AND pi.FelPersoana = 0
) x

WHERE
    Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

UPDATE c
SET
    CoeficientPersoane =
        ISNULL(x.CoeficientPersoane,0)
FROM app.CalculPersoaneIntretinere c

OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT
        SUM(ISNULL(tp.Procent,0)) AS CoeficientPersoane
    FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere pi

    INNER JOIN app.TipPersoana tp
        ON tp.FelPersoana = pi.FelPersoana
       AND ISNULL(tp.Grad,-1) = ISNULL(pi.Grad,-1)
       AND tp.Anul = c.Anul

    WHERE
        pi.Marca = c.Marca

    AND pi.FelPersoana IN (1,2,4)

    AND pi.DataDeInceput <=
        EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(c.Anul,c.Luna,1))

    AND
    (
        pi.DataDeSfarsit IS NULL
        OR pi.DataDeSfarsit >=
           DATEFROMPARTS(c.Anul,c.Luna,1)
    )

) x

WHERE
    Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

UPDATE cpi
SET
    cpi.DeducereStandard = d.Deducere
FROM app.CalculPersoaneIntretinere cpi

INNER JOIN app.BazaCalculBrut bcb
    ON bcb.Marca = cpi.Marca
   AND bcb.CodSucursala = cpi.CodSucursala
   AND bcb.Anul = cpi.Anul
   AND bcb.Luna = cpi.Luna

INNER JOIN app.TSDeducereBaza d
    ON d.Anul = cpi.Anul

   AND ISNULL(bcb.BrutImpozabil,0)
       BETWEEN d.VenitMin AND d.VenitMax

   AND d.PersoaneIntretinere =
       CASE
           WHEN cpi.NumarPersoane > 4
           THEN 4
           ELSE cpi.NumarPersoane
       END

WHERE
    cpi.Anul = @Anul
AND cpi.Luna = @Luna
AND cpi.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
